name: Iowa DNR Wildlife Diversity Habitat Management Grants
summary: Small single-year grants for habitat management projects that benefit nongame wildlife in Iowa, in line with the state Wildlife Action Plan. Any organization engaged in wildlife conservation management can apply through the DNR SlideRoom portal.

eligibility.rule: Organization is involved in land management with wildlife conservation purposes.
Project has management for non-game wildlife as its primary focus.
Project work is not completed before funding is available.
Additional funding is listed and secured when the project costs much more than requested.

calls.label: 2027 Habitat Management Grants (due 10 November 2026)
calls.recurring: Proposals due at midnight on 10 November; the page does not state the year.

status.quote: Due date for proposals is November 10, 2026.

recurring.quote: Deadline for proposals is midnight on November 10th.

deadline.quote: Due date for proposals is November 10, 2026.

geography.quote: Successful applicants must be doing work in Iowa.

access.quote: You must apply for each of these programs through the DNR's Slideroom Portal.

amount.quote: The maximum allowable funding ask per proposal is $7,500.

co_finance_required.quote: No match is required for these funds.

window.quote: Due date for proposals is November 10, 2026.

applicant_types.quote: All DNR Partners including County Conservation Boards, Sportsman's Groups, nonprofit conservation organizations. Any organization involved in land management with wildlife conservation purposes.

effort.quote: DUE DATE: Proposals must be received before midnight on November 10, 2026.
All proposals received will be reviewed by an IDNR technical review committee and will be scored based upon:

eligibility.quote: Any organization involved in land management with wildlife conservation purposes.
Projects to be considered will have management for non-game wildlife as their primary focus
